newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong off after flat sales detailed.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong off after flat sales detailed.

text.p: Shares of Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd fell after the company released details of its latest sale of residential property at prices below market expectations, brokers said on Friday.
Cheung Kong shares had fallen HK$1.50 or 1.98 percent to HK$74.25 in afternoon trade on volume of 3.61 million shares.

"It disappointed investors because the flats were offered at a price below market expectations of about HK$9,000 to HK$10,000 a square foot," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage. "It gave investors an excuse to sell down the shares."
Brokers said another reason for the drop was index futures related selling on fears of a possible U.S. interest rate hike.
Cheung Kong said it would offer 78 residential units in its luxury residential Laguna Verda development in Kowloon for sale at an average price of HK$8,286 per square foot.
